definition: male on four layers, and on the one that is meant to feel it, mostly just autistic

settled:
The layers are my genes, my body, what I feel, the story I tell and how I act. Four land male.

The felt one reads neither, because I feel autistic far more strongly than I feel gendered.

Most people grow a felt gender by sampling without noticing, the same implicit learner that builds language. My sampler is missing, most likely as part of the experiential memory I do not have, one more implicit learner in me that does not run.

A safety reading fills the slot. The felt channel delivers no gender I feel from inside. It reports how my surroundings sit on my nervous system, read off the body like any other signal, and femininity is one of my strongest safe signals.

I ranked myself against a prominent set of male and female archetypes, pairwise, across every attribute, on the positive and the negative framing of each. That put my story and my behaviour at least eighty percent male, though not neurotypical male. It measures those two layers and says nothing about the felt one.
